sourceText: Example: So long as they had not already made a Break Attack this turn, Nightingale would provoke a separate Break Attack from both Cave Sickles if she moved into any space.
proposalText: Exemplo: Se ainda não tiver feito um Ataque de Oportunidade neste turno, Nightingale provocaria um Ataque de Oportunidade de cada um dos dois Cave Sickles ao entrar em qualquer espaço.
terminologyPendingHumanReview: Break Attack → Ataque de Oportunidade: glossary maps “Breaking Attack”; exact variant relation still needs editorial confirmation.
Nightingale and Cave Sickle are preserved as source names pending glossary confirmation.
note: Only the structurally validated Example unit is proposed. Existing Payload translation id 298 is preserved in the isolated export snapshot and is not modified.
